messages:
Jamal: Quick sync — proposal: ship a 3-part community mini-series next month: 1) a repo-first tutorial/refapp, 2) a short benchmark post with clear cost+latency takeaways, 3) a live 30-min webinar that demos the refapp and answers infra questions. Who can take what? :rocket:
Mia: Love it. My idea: make tutorials tiny and incremental — Quickstart (10m), Add routing & caching (15m), Deploy to Private (15m). each with a GIF + full repo example.
Lena: +1. For the benchmark post we should show realistic workloads (seq lengths, batch sizes) and an easy-to-run harness. also call out routing/fallback impacts. :eyes: 
Sanjay: I can own the bench harness. propose targets: seqs 512/1024/2048, batches 1/8/32, measure p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec and cost-per-1k-tokens. will submit a script.
Eve: Marketing ops checklist: UTMs, gated webinar sign-up (HubSpot), lead-routing to SDR queue "oss-refapp", GA+Amplitude events, and templates for follow-ups. Need the form fields early.
Mia: Drafting blog headlines A/B for the tutorial: A) "Build a tiny inference refapp in 30 minutes" B) "Ship a production-ready inference refapp: tutorial + benchmark". Which tone do we want — friendly quickstart or product/enterprise?
Jamal: Lean friendly quickstart for community channels, product-forward in newsletter. We'll A/B test subject lines. Newsletter subject candidates: "Tiny refapp + live demo" vs "Save on LLM inference — live demo".
marketing-bot: Calendar event created — "Refapp Mini-Series Planning" scheduled for 2026-06-02 10:00 (link: https://calendar.example/evt).
Sanjay: bench script snippet (will be in repo):
```bash
python run_bench.py --model redwood-small --seq 2048 --batch 8 --measure p50,p95 --output bench.json
```
Mia: Social copy drafts:
- Tweet A: "New mini refapp + live demo — build, benchmark, deploy. Sign up: https://rwd.in/mini_series #OSS #inference"
- Tweet B: "Cut inference cost and latency — join our live demo where we walk a refapp from repo to private deploy. https://rwd.in/mini_series"
Eve: For inbound routing: HubSpot form should add tags: source=mini_series, content=tutorial, interest=private_deploy. Then auto-assign to SDR list 'oss-refapp' if company_size>50 or interest=private_deploy. Smaller leads get nurture drip.
Lena: Can we reuse the tutorial repo as a workshop for community night? make a "lab" branch with tasks and a small dataset — good for community retention.
Mia: Timeline suggestion: Week1: write drafts + repo scaffolding. Week2: reviews + bench runs. Week3: publish tutorial & benchmark, open webinar signups. Week4: webinar + follow-up email + gated asset (checklist + code).
Jamal: Owners: Mia (tutorials + social), Sanjay (bench + repo harness), Eve (forms + lead routing + emails), Lena (community lab + workshop). I'll coordinate PR and newsletter slots. @everyone please ack with a quick thumbs. :thumbsup:
Mia: ack :thumbsup:
Sanjay: ack :thumbsup:
Lena: ack :thumbsup:
Eve: ack — will start HubSpot form draft today.
Jamal: Also note messaging iteration — we should capture two KPIs per variant: CTR on sign-up and conversion to demo attendance. keep copy short, benefit-first (cost/latency) for enterprise audience.
Mia: I'll prepare two short hero texts for A/B and paste in this thread before EOD.
marketing-bot: Reminder set: publish checklist due 2026-06-09.
Jamal: Perfect. If anyone hits blocking infra or data issues ping me directly. Thanks team — excited to get this live. :tada:
